parsed.explanation: The quoted sentence appears verbatim in the subcase 'every piece of Q satisfies ≤ τ' and literally asserts that Q's pieces refine the two midpoint halves. The witness meets that subcase's hypotheses: n=2 (bins {1,2,4}, τ=2, large bin length 4), Xiang's two cuts at offsets 1.5 and 2.5 inside the large bin give Q={1.5,1,1.5}, all ≤ τ. Yet the middle piece [1.5,2.5] strictly straddles the midpoint offset 2, so Q is not a refinement of the two sub-sticks; the claim is false as stated. The ensuing 'cuts distribute among the two sub-sticks / apply induction to each half' reasoning presupposes this refinement (and each half has length 2^{n-1}, not the B_{n-1} total 2^n−1). Nowhere else does the text treat this subcase for all n — only n≤3 numerics and a conjectured stronger claim — so the lower-bound induction is invalid as written.
